name: Ezra Bloom
source:
Ezra Bloom, Elijah's older brother who went missing years ago. It turned out that he was trying to escape with his lover Hans from his father's wrath, but everything went terribly wrong: Hans died, and Ezra was stranded on a desert island for eight years until Haley and I rescued him.

Season 2
[spoiler] Since Ezra had nowhere to go after Haley and I rescued him, Arthur offered him a job at Cordale. After Jacob died protecting me from Beatrice, the Academy needed someone to overlook the Duelling club, and Ezra got this appointment. Even though he hasn't finished his studies and is far less experienced than Jacob, Ezra looks confident that he will do well.[/spoiler]
